boundary_source_review_operation.scope: Original a746 ro/snapshot source and schema DDL text inspection only

findings: The complete source contains nine fixed parameterized SELECTs. Original run/invocation/project/task identifiers and the session join constrain all lookups; optional lease/session/result rows can be absent without claiming release or terminality.
Three fixed regular SQLite paths use mode=ro, PRAGMA query_only=ON and BEGIN, with final query_only==1 and total_changes==0 checks. Real/effective UID999 and GID988 and Python -I -S -B are required.
Only stdlib imports are present. There is no application initializer, schema mutation, network request, credential-file read, model dispatch, business write or service action.

Payloads and potentially identifying lease/session values leave only SHA256, raw UTF8 length and nullness; states/counts/numeric metadata are bounded. The SQLite value cap, group cap, 15-second reader deadline and 64KiB output cap remain explicit.

The source deliberately reports identity_matches=false as observation metadata. README's earlier claim that identity mismatch raises was corrected without source/SQL changes; this status observation is not original-run acceptance.
The three read transactions are not cross-database atomic; counts, absent rows, expired leases or a complete observation do not authorize recovery, quiescence or deployment.
